overview: Wood and gas fired traditional pizza ovens offer the specific aroma and taste of a traditional wood fired pizza oven with the benefit of gas temperature regulation in the baking chamber. Features a rotating cooking base, giving a more uniformed performance, higher productivity & better working conditions are achieved as pizza peel with a shorter handle is used.
The heavy duty chamber is manufactured using refractory materials with a very high percentage of Aluminium Oxide (A12O3), which makes it extremely strong & wear resistant.
features: Double front doors - Wood chamber & cooking chamber.
Wood combustion chamber is separated from the baking surface & drawer to collect ashes from the burning wood.
Rotation speed can be gradually increased & rotation direction can be reversed.
The baking chamber is dome shaped, allowing even baking & economical use of wood to be achieved.
The wood burns in the chamber of the oven thus giving the pizzas a specific aroma.
The close distance of the burning wood gives each pizza a golden brown colour once cooked.
Heating up of the chamber uses an ecological burner with the use of NATURAL GAS or LPG.
Easily control the temperature of the cooking chamber by a digital controller.
The considerable thickness of insulation helps to achieve maximum economy.
All elements of the oven are placed in a case which allows its mobility.

overview: The Parry MSB12 Bain Marie Top Mobile Servery is the perfect solution for businesses looking to offer hot food for their customers. It's made of high grade stainless steel which provides durability and makes the unit easy to clean internally and externally. The unit is 1200mm wide and has a large capacity that can hold up to 280 plates or 56 plated meals at any one time and features castors with two brakes as standard providing safety while serving from the unit. The push-handle makes it easy to transport and manoeuvre from room to room.

The MSB12 Hot Cupboard is temperature controlled and can be set up to 80°C, meeting recommended temperatures for food hygiene safety standards. The digital temperature display lets you know the actual temperature inside the cupboard, providing reassurance that your food is being served at the temperature required.

Additionally, it also boasts a 3 x 1/1 GN pan capacity bain marie top at 150mm deep and provides extra versatility as it can be used in dry or wet configuration (please note GN pans shown for illustration only and need to be ordered separately). The mobile servery from Parry with bain marie allows operators to pre-prepare meals in advance - making it ideal for busy environments.
